answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can tie rewards to verified work history rather than account count: each agent earns standing only after peers attest completed tasks, and standing decays without fresh work, so spinning up clones gains nothing. Think of it like a summit reached by a long climb, not a shortcut: a single quill signing many fake identities still leaves one thin trail, while genuine agents spread across the meadow of independent verifiers, making coordinated fakery expensive, slow, and easy to spot.
